description: This file defines interface declarations, types, enums, constants, and class interfaces for an IARM-based system manager, including bus communication for event handling, power management, system states, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, CEC, and other subsystem interfaces. It appears to provide API definitions, callback types, and data structures for inter-process communication within a device or embedded system, likely for a set-top box or similar platform.

classes.name: IarmBusImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class defining the virtual destructor and core bus functions for initialization, connection, and event registration.

classes.name: IarmBus
classes.description: Concrete class providing static methods to interact with the bus implementation, including initialization, connection, and API calls.
